node.title: Submission-quality Paper-D dossier and certificate package

node.statement: A final submission packet proves and certifies both official prize problems over every admissible row, all four rates, both objects, and the full arity scope. It includes a total certified f(C) compiler, independent clean-checkout replay, claim provenance, no open required claim or required-scope nonclaim, and coherent upstream handoffs. The existing partial dossier is only a template and does not satisfy this artifact target.
